name: smwgraphics-trials-of-mana-mirage-palace-hallways
title: Trials of Mana - Mirage Palace (Hallways)
description:
Two Mirage Palace foregrounds. The map16 is a bit of a mess, but thankfully I included two sample levels taken from a hack I was making to show you how to assemble the foregrounds.

Works great with carol's moving clouds background, or anything else that works in a half 3D view.
